gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-atkinson-hy: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has lowercase eyes as big as washers, and its rounds stay open like an unlatched hook. Capture Smallz up top is the raw, tactical one.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-biryani: Biryani is a sans with a big clear eye on every e and no thick-and-thin swing at all. And Capture Smallz is the one with the raw, tactical heft, big-bodied where Biryani stays clean.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-blinker: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical look that grabs the eye first. Blinker follows with sans-serif lines that hold their thickness, a drawing so uniform it makes the heading look wilder.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-carrois-got: Approachable is the word for Carrois Gothic SC, whose curves all finish with a clear opening. But Capture Smallz is the raw, tactical half, so the pair has bite up top and openness below.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-chivo: Approachable and a bit professional, Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve. Capture Smallz brings the raw, tactical edge, so the two feel like rough and smooth.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-chocolate-c: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase that looks built for impact. And Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-comme: Comme reads smooth, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Against it, Capture Smallz adds a raw, tactical heading, and that gap is what makes the pair work.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-cossette-te: Rough meets tidy here, with Capture Smallz big-bodied and tactical above. And Cossette Texte keeps a prominent x-height, with wide-eyed e shapes drawn at a single width, giving the pair a clear split.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-duru-sans: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, its big-bodied lowercase filling every line it touches. Duru Sans then runs a clean sans below, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate while ascenders hardly show.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-fresca: Raw, tactical and big-bodied, Capture Smallz hits first. Fresca is a plain sans with no calligraphic thinning, and its short ascenders over big bowls give the pair a sharp, friendly split.
